title: The Crooked Choir
premise: Isandro Okonkwo, a cartographer of unmapped realms, has spent years quietly keeping the ledgers of the Guild of Impossible Things, trading in souls, shadows, and songs that shouldn't exist. When the crown declares a hunt for anyone with the gift of mapping what isn't there, Isandro learns their own name was sold to the court beneath the mountain decades ago by a parent desperate to hide them. To survive, Isandro must steal back their soul before the last dragon-fire gutters out and the guild's protections die with it. In the end, Isandro chooses truth over loyalty to the guild that raised them, exposing its ledgers to save the hunted, and reclaims their soul not as property but as inheritance—rewriting the map so no one can be sold again.
about_author: Mara Ashgrove is the pen name of a former archivist who spent a decade cataloguing maps of places that never existed. They write fantasy about people who keep dangerous records.

chapters.title: The Ledger of Small Debts
chapters.summary: Isandro's POV. We meet them in the guild's back rooms, balancing accounts of traded shadows and bottled lullabies while hiding their gift from even their closest colleagues. Emotional beat: quiet dread beneath routine—the sense that invisibility is a debt accruing interest.

chapters.title: A Proclamation in Red Wax
chapters.summary: Isandro's POV. The crown's hunt is announced; guildmaster Vess burns half the ledgers overnight and orders silence. Isandro realizes their own pages are missing. Emotional beat: betrayal disguised as protection.

chapters.title: What the Ink Remembers
chapters.summary: Isandro's POV, with flashbacks. Examining surviving ledger fragments, Isandro finds an entry in their mother's handwriting: a soul, sold, price 'one hidden child.' Emotional beat: vertigo of discovering your identity was a transaction.

chapters.title: The Cartographer's Oath
chapters.summary: Isandro's POV. Vess reveals the guild's founding bargain: dragon-fire protects members' names, but it is guttering, and when it dies every recorded soul reverts to the mountain court. Emotional beat: loyalty tested against self-preservation.

chapters.title: Down the Unmapped Stair
chapters.summary: Isandro's POV. Using their forbidden gift, Isandro maps a passage beneath the city toward the mountain court, accompanied by Odile, a guild thief who owes them a debt. Emotional beat: first act of open defiance, exhilarating and terrifying.

chapters.title: The Toll of Names
chapters.summary: Odile's POV. At the border of the under-court, a gatekeeper demands a true name as toll; Odile pays with her dead brother's instead. Emotional beat: grief weaponized into currency.

chapters.title: Court Beneath the Mountain
chapters.summary: Isandro's POV. The under-court is a mirrored palace where sold souls sing in a crooked choir for the Mountain Queen's amusement. Isandro hears their own voice among them. Emotional beat: horror of recognition.

chapters.title: An Audience of Mirrors
chapters.summary: Isandro's POV. The Mountain Queen offers Isandro a place at court if they will map the realms she intends to conquer. Emotional beat: temptation—the first time anyone has valued their gift openly.

chapters.title: The Crooked Choir Sings
chapters.summary: Choir-soul POV (a minor character, Wren). The enslaved souls describe their fading: each verse sung erases a memory of who they were. Emotional beat: elegy; stakes made intimate.

chapters.title: Ledgers and Lies
chapters.summary: Vess's POV. Back above, Vess bargains with the crown's witch-hunter, offering guild secrets to buy time—and offering Isandro's location as final payment. Emotional beat: institutional loyalty curdling into treachery.

chapters.title: The Debt Collector
chapters.summary: Odile's POV. The witch-hunter corners Odile; she escapes only by burning her own guild mark, severing her protection. Emotional beat: choosing exile over complicity.

chapters.title: Mother's Handwriting
chapters.summary: Isandro's POV. A dying guild scribe confesses that Isandro's mother didn't sell them to hide them—she sold herself, her soul entering the choir in exchange for Isandro's freedom, which Vess later voided. Emotional beat: rage and love entangled.

chapters.title: Two Souls, One Page
chapters.summary: Isandro's POV. Isandro locates the ledger page binding both their soul and their mother's to the court. Stealing it requires the Queen's seal. Emotional beat: resolve hardening into plan.

chapters.title: The Thief's Bargain
chapters.summary: Odile's POV. Odile returns underground to help, negotiating with a disgraced court steward who wants out. Emotional beat: unlikely alliance; trust rebuilt from shared damage.

chapters.title: Guttersong
chapters.summary: Isandro's POV. The last dragon-fire flickers; above ground, unprotected guild members are being taken. Time collapses. Emotional beat: panic, urgency, the cost of waiting too long.

chapters.title: Theft of a Seal
chapters.summary: Odile's POV. Odile and the steward steal the Queen's seal during the choir's midnight performance, but the steward is caught and gives up Odile's name under torture. Emotional beat: sacrifice and guilt.

chapters.title: The Queen's Offer, Refused
chapters.summary: Isandro's POV. Confronted by the Queen, Isandro refuses her bargain and declares the choir's souls were never hers to buy—inheritance cannot be transferred by fraud. Emotional beat: identity claimed aloud for the first time.

chapters.title: When the Fire Goes Out
chapters.summary: Isandro's POV. The dragon-fire dies; the Queen moves to claim every bound soul at once. Isandro uses their gift to redraw the bindings mid-claim, redirecting the claim onto the ledger itself. Emotional beat: climax—gift fully embraced as power.

chapters.title: Ash and Ink
chapters.summary: Multiple POVs briefly. The burning ledger frees the choir; the Queen, bound to her own contract, crumbles with her mirrors. Isandro's mother's soul passes on, finally free, leaving one word: 'stay.' Emotional beat: catharsis and loss.

chapters.title: The Guild Reckoned
chapters.summary: Isandro's POV. Isandro returns and exposes Vess's bargain to the surviving guild, refusing the master's chair but demanding the ledgers become public record—a registry of protection, not ownership. Emotional beat: loyalty redefined as accountability.

chapters.title: Mapping What Remains
chapters.summary: Isandro's POV. Isandro and Odile begin mapping the freed souls' homeward paths, the guild reborn as sanctuary rather than market. Emotional beat: tender rebuilding; purpose found.

chapters.title: The First Honest Page
chapters.summary: Isandro's POV, epilogue. Isandro writes a new ledger whose first entry is their own true name, freely given, witnessed by the choir's survivors. Emotional beat: peace—identity as choice, inheritance reclaimed.
